B0CWTKW9BB.title: Onvis Matter Over Thread Smart Plug, Smart Mini Outlet, Works with Apple Home, Alexa & Google Home, 15A/1800W （1Pack）
bullets: 【Full Compatibility with Matter】This smart plug is Matter-certified and works with all certified smart home platforms, including Apple Home, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and Samsung SmartThings. Even when your home internet goes offline, all Matter-certified devices in your local area network (LAN) will work smoothly.

【More Responsive with Thread】This smart plug is enabled with Thread technology, which makes it more responsive and efficient. You can control it remotely when you're away from home, as long as you have a HomePod mini or Apple TV.

【App and Voice Control】Manage your devices effortlessly through the app or with simple voice commands via Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, or Apple Siri. Whether you’re at home or away, control is always within reach.

【Schedule and Timer】Set personalized schedules and timers to automate your devices. Turn lights, appliances, or other connected devices on/off at specific times, giving you ultimate convenience and energy savings.

【Compact Design, Maximum Utility】Featuring a space-saving design, this smart plug won’t block adjacent outlets. Its compact size allows you to stack two plugs in a single outlet, making it both practical and versatile.

【100% Privacy】There is no cloud, registration, or data tracking with this smart plug. It provides local intelligence and direct communication without bridge or cloud dependency, ensuring complete privacy for you.

【Grouping and Sharing】Create a group in your app, connect multiple plugs to your home, and turn on/off the connected devices all at once. Share your plugs with family members, so everyone can enjoy a connected home.
